title: How HSP GRUPPE builds AI capabilities for tax advisory
summary: HSP GRUPPE 通过采用 ChatGPT Enterprise，在税务咨询领域构建 AI 能力，显著提升了生产力、工作质量，并为客户服务创造了更多容量。
highlights: HSP GRUPPE uses ChatGPT Enterprise to boost productivity and improve work quality.
The adoption of AI creates more capacity for tax advisory and client service.
